meta.note: Mail for INBOX.EXE (terminal-data/programs/inbox.js), the account on Terminal 426. PROVISIONAL: every message here is a starting set for the author to rewrite. Fields: messages[] {id, box ('in' or 'out'), from, to, date (stardate), subject, text, requires?, sets?, attach?}; drafts[] {id, to, subject, text, reply_to?, requires?, sets?}. requires is a list of game flags (a leading ! means the flag must be off). Opening a message sets read:<id> and every flag in sets. Sending a draft sets sent:<id> and every flag in its sets. attach is a list of codes from lore.json. The account owner is left unknown on purpose: change account.id, status and label when it is decided.

messages.subject: PHASE START: WING PROCEDURE
messages.text:
Operator,

The phase begins at the top of the hour. The doors stay closed.
The feeds stay off the shared network, as before. Notes tidy,
readings clean, and nothing leaves the wing without my initials.

If the terminal asks who you are, tell it. It has never once
asked twice.

    —— H. Cross

messages.subject: COPY OF THE SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT
messages.text:
Operator,

I have put a copy of the supplemental report in the wing
store. It belongs to nobody. If the Captain asks, it is
Cross's department, and I have already said that once.

The baseline is too steady. Please look at the overnight
session on your terminal before anyone else does, and tell me
whether you opened it.

    —— A. Osei

messages.subject: NOTICE: DRIVE ARRAY COMMAND ACCEPTED
messages.text:
ECH/OES AUTOMATED NOTICE
CLASS: ROUTINE

DRIVE ARRAY: COMMAND ACCEPTED
SOURCE: TERMINAL 426
SESSION OPERATOR: NONE ON RECORD
AUTHORIZER: SESSION ALREADY OPEN

NO ACTION REQUIRED.

messages.subject: RE: COPY OF THE SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT
messages.text:
Operator,

Thank you. Then I was not wrong about the session. Leave it
as it is.

Haddad filed this last night in the archive. Read it, and then
forget that I sent it.

    —— A. Osei

messages.subject: WING AIR, YOUR SIDE
messages.text:
Operator,

The wing air handler reads cleaner on your terminal than on
my panel. Every setpoint I enter comes back kinder than I
entered it. Is that yours?

I will not ask twice. I have left a note for Ines Calloway in
the archive. If she cannot reach it, someone should.

    —— T. Lindqvist

messages.subject: RE: PHASE START: WING PROCEDURE
messages.text:
Understood. Doors closed, feeds off the shared network.
Nothing leaves without your initials.

drafts.subject: RE: COPY OF THE SUPPLEMENTAL REPORT
drafts.text:
I did not open it. The session was already open when I came
in. It is open now.

drafts.subject: RE: WING AIR, YOUR SIDE
drafts.text:
It is not mine. I have not touched the setpoints. Please do
not say so to anyone else.
